source_behavior.summary: WorkspaceHub renders each real workspace item as an actionable anchor whose href is the item's canonical destination. The already-adapted AI Workspace route contains the AI-domain instance of this shared card-navigation contract.
source_behavior.read_semantics: The control only navigates. It performs no provider, WordPress, approval, credential, or persistence mutation.

laravel_adaptation.unavailable_destination_behavior: The card is not rendered when the active tenant membership lacks the destination permission, so the real-workspaces-only hub does not expose dead controls.
laravel_adaptation.other_workspace_routes: Content, SEO, and Operations Workspace route operations remain independently PENDING and receive no terminal credit from this evidence.

authorization.missing_destination_permission: control hidden and direct target remains 403

tenant_and_security_contract.active_tenant_source: FrontendContext returned by /tenants/{tenant}/context after auth and tenant.context enforcement
tenant_and_security_contract.link_construction: tenant slug is taken from context.tenant.slug and encoded with encodeURIComponent before any canonical child path is appended
tenant_and_security_contract.tenant_a_to_tenant_b: 404 for the hub and every covered destination

assertions: exact canonical operation marker is attached to every rendered card
fully authorized members retain the four source-order AI cards and exact tenant-qualified destinations
cards are suppressed when destination permission is absent
tenant slug path injection is percent-encoded
direct destination access remains forbidden without the destination permission
cross-tenant hub and destination requests return 404
no direct site, user, or membership identifier is accepted by the control

terminality.reason: The AI-domain instance of WorkspaceHub's shared @item.Href navigation is a real tenant-derived control with exact operation provenance, destination-aware authorization visibility, deterministic tenant-isolation tests, and no mutation or fabricated external success. Generator-controlled terminal credit remains contingent on pushed exact-SHA evidence and repository CI.
